title: I2I: PubMatic Amp-ad GDPR/CCPA support
body:
## Summary
How to add support for passing GDPR and CCPA consent in ad-request from amp-ad?
Can somebody help here?

/cc @ampproject/wg-approvers
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Hello @pm-harshad-mane Have you tried https://github.com/ampproject/amphtml/blob/master/ads/README.md#amp-consent-integration

Let me know if there's any question.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Thanks @zhouyx for a quick reply.
I am wondering how our code will know if the provided consent is GDPR consent or CCPA consent string?

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
There's a feature request for AMP to pass the consent type information as well. #27907 
Before that's added, we learnt that people determine the consent string type based on the length.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
sounds good @zhouyx .
Thank you for your help :-)

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: Closing this now, feel free to reopen with any questions or concerns :)

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
